# Portable-export fixtures

`export-0.8.oryxis` and `export-0.9.oryxis` are forward-compat
regression inputs: they hold the exact payload SHAPES older releases
wrote, so `store/tests/portable_hardening.rs::imports_fixture_export_*`
proves current code keeps reading files produced by 0.8.x / 0.9.0.

Contents are fully synthetic (no real credentials): one group, one
connection with password (`fixture-conn-pw`), one snippet, one setting.
The export password is `fixture`.

## Provenance / how to regenerate

Generated by `regenerate_fixtures` in
`crates/oryxis-vault/src/store/tests/portable_hardening.rs`:

```bash
cargo test -p oryxis-vault regenerate_fixtures -- --ignored
```

The generator exports a scratch vault with the CURRENT code, then
prunes the payload back to each version's shape and re-seals it, so
field names always come from the real serializers and only the
version deltas are hand-maintained:

- 0.8.3 -> 0.9.0: connections gained `totp_secret`
  (verified against `git show v0.8.3:crates/oryxis-vault/src/portable.rs`).
- 0.9.0 -> 1.0: payload root gained `custom_terminal_themes`.

The sealing crypto (`store::encrypt`: Argon2id + ChaCha20Poly1305,
salt + nonce + ciphertext) and the `ORYXIS` header (version 1) are
unchanged since 0.8.3, so re-sealing with current code is
byte-format-identical to what the old builds produced.

Regenerate ONLY after a deliberate format change, and when a new
release changes the payload shape, add an `export-<version>.oryxis`
here instead of touching the existing ones.
